execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Attachment" (
  "fileName" text,
  "fileURL" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "taskId" text NOT NULL,
  "uploadedById" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Board" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Comment" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "taskId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Org" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."OrgMember" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "orgId" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "OrgMember_role_check_ddb31015" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'MEMBER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Project" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "orgId" text NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ProjectMember" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Section" (
  "boardId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Section_status_check_390acd24" CHECK ("status" IN ('UPCOMING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Task" (
  "authorId" text NOT NULL,
  "boardId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "priority" text NOT NULL,
  "sectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Task_priority_check_8918b779" CHECK ("priority" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'URGENT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TaskMapping" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "taskId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "profilePictureUrl" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
